snippet.title: Nautic XP on Steam – New Ship Simulation Experience!
snippet.description:
Set sail with Nautic XP – the new ship simulation experience built for true maritime enthusiasts!
Discover vast open waters, detailed ship handling, and dynamic weather as you explore realistic harbors and coastlines inspired by real-world data.

🧭 Currently in development – but you can already follow our journey:
✅ Wishlist us now on Steam
✅ Try the upcoming demo (soon on our website!)
✅ Join the community and shape the future of Nautic XP

⚓ Developed using Unreal Engine 5
🗺️ World data powered by OpenStreetMap and DWD weather services
🚢 Complex Ship handling

🌐 Learn more: https://nauticxp.com/
💬 Join the crew: discord.gg/p6eXSbUGQK

Music: "Can't beat" by "The soundings" (YouTube Audio Library)
